intent: 課題の締め切りを確かめる
ja: 提出はいつまでですか。

variants.en: Is that due Friday or Monday?

flags.note: どの要の部分も 10 件に届かない（MICASE の学生の発話で数えた）ので ①②③ で判定しない。MICASE の学生の発話では首位が 3 件未満（due on friday | due friday | due on monday | due monday | due next week 1 件）。Math Stack Exchange の質問で最も多い要の部分 due on friday | due friday | due on monday | due monday | due next week（9 件。3 件以上）なので使われている。en の要の部分 when is it due | when is that due | when's it due | when is this due | when's that due | when is the homework due | when is the paper due | when are they due は 0 件。en は Math Stack Exchange では選ばない。register は主張しない。
